propositions: Three independent spawn sites (push.py, enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py) duplicate detached-child PYTHONPATH bootstrap logic, detach flags, and cwd handling without a shared helper
A cwd omission bug (3198-438c-72a5-470f) propagated across all three sites because the pattern was replicated by imitation rather than code reuse
A fourth copy-paste site (gc_trigger.py) landed concurrently during review, confirming the pattern recurs without structural prevention

The helper spawn_detached must consolidate PYTHONPATH bootstrap, platform detach flags, and durable cwd in _proc.py (a stdlib-only leaf) while preserving per-caller exception handling and environment construction
A static test must enforce that detached spawn signature tokens (DETACHED_PROCESS, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, sys.path.insert re-entry) appear only in _proc.py to prevent future copy-paste propagation
The repo_root cwd fallback accepts raising behavior for long-lived in-process callers (daemon threads, reconcilers), since detached children are now anchored by spawn_detached
